1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5 Bb4 4.c3 Ba5 5.B.strategy: Takes the knight before Black can regroup: after either recapture the e5 pawn is loose, and ...Qd4 is no longer a defence because the c3 pawn covers d4. White wins a pawn.

The natural recapture, giving Black the bishop pair, but it cannot save the e5 pawn: after Nxe5 the c3 pawn covers d4, so the queen cannot win the pawn back, and Black must find compensation in the bishops.
1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5 Bb4 4.c3 Ba5 5.B.name: Ruy Lopez: Alapin Defence, Alapin Gambit
